title: Rav Hamnuna Zuta or Zuti
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A precious prayer of his remains to us, as in [Berakhot 17a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.17a.3), which he used to say: “My God, before I was formed I was unworthy, and now that I have been formed it is as though I had not been formed; I am dust in my life, all the more so in my death,” etc. There, at [Berakhot 31a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.31a.3), the Rabbis said to Rav Hamnuna Zuti at the wedding of Mar son of Ravina, “Let the Master sing for us.” He said: “Woe to us, for we shall die; woe to us, for we shall die.” They said to him: “What shall we respond after you?” He said: “Where is the Torah and where is the mitzvah that will protect us?”[^1]

notes.text: The linked Berakhot gives the same words after Rava’s prayer and as Rav Hamnuna Zuti’s Yom Kippur confession. At the wedding of Mar son of Ravina, Hamnuna gives the song and then tells the sages how to answer. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1054&lang=en) records both occasions.
